title: WPMS/98/2011 of CENTURY TEXTILES AND INDUSTRIES LTD Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND AND ORS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
WRIT PETITION (MS) No. 98 of 2011
Century Textiles & Industries Limited. ÖÖPetitioner.
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others. ÖRespondents.
Present: Mr. Tanveer Alam Khan, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Mr. P.C. Bisht, Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
Honíble B.S. Verma, J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as
for the respondents.
2. By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has
sought the following relief:
ìa. To issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus commanding the
respondents to take action against the
agitators, either they may be contractorís
employees or they may be outsiders, who
create a lawlessness either in the factory or out
side the factory, at the unit of the petitioner
situated at Century Pulp and Paper, Lalkua
district Nainital and the respondents may also
be directed to maintain law and order in the
entire area of the unit and outside unit of the
petitioner.
b. To issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus commanding the
respondents not to permit any body to cause
any hindrance in the peaceful working of the
factory of the unit of the petitioner situated at
Century Pulp and Paper, Lalkua district
Nainital and they also be directed to restrain
any person who agitates in any manner
whatsoever be, within a radius of 200 metres
from the outer periphery of the unit of the
petitioner i.e. Century Pulp and Paper, Lalkua
district Nainital.
c. To award cost of the writ petition or any
other relief which Honíble This court may deem
fit.î
3. According to the petitioner, the workers of the
Contractor as well as some outsiders created havoc

2
environment in the entire factory premises. They used
bamboos in their hands and started beating some of the
employees of the petitioner factory and some how some of
the officers and employees of the petitioner as well as
their families saved their lives from these miscreants.
4. It is the contention of the petitioner that he has
made representation to the Authorities in this regard and
has also reported the matter to Police Station Kotwali,
Lalkuan, Nainital, but as of now nothing has been done.
5. In the facts and circumstances of the case, liberty is
given to the petitioner to make fresh representations to
the Senior Superintendent of Police, Nainital as well as
Collector, Nainital regarding his grievance. After receiving
of the said representations, the Collector as well as
Senior Superintendent of Police, Nainital shall ensure the
law and order situation at the petitioner unit, in
accordance with law so that peaceful atmosphere can be
maintained within the premises of the petitionerís
factory.
6. With the aforesaid direction, the instant writ
petition is disposed of.
7. All the pending applications stand disposed of
accordingly.
8. Let a copy of this order be issued today.
(B.S. Verma, J.)
Vacation Judge
11.1.2011
Rathour
